text:
Event: Varworth summit.
Budget: 41,000.
Staffing: Una, Greta, and Ada are out; Pia, Opal, and Jonah are covering respectively. Bram is out. Ada and Finn, Cora and Nils, and Kira and Esme are swapping desks. Leon is involved.
Logistics: Print room is being repainted (morning noise). Loading bay is being repainted (evening noise). East wing coffee machine works. North office is free in the morning. Garden studio is too cold in the morning. East wing is too cold in the afternoon. Lift near north office is slow. Afternoon stand-up moved to east wing; evening stand-up to harbour room. Umbrellas left in north office and loading bay.
Preferences/Requests: Pia, Kira, and Hugo want the harbour room kept clear for visitors. Esme prefers the loading bay for reviews.
Action Items: Send morning meeting notes to Una. Send afternoon meeting notes to Opal. Library annex details noted.
